long.title: Ocean Animals So Weird They Look Fake. One Has a See-Through Head

gemini.fixes:
1. **Replace the deceptive, static opening hook with real 4K footage (00:00–00:15 & 05:08–07:25)**
   * **What is heard:** The narrator promises, *"This fish has a see-through head and its eyes move around inside it. Scientists just filmed it in 4K"* (00:00–00:06).
   * **What is seen:** In the first 2 seconds and through 00:15, the screen shows a completely motionless, comic-filtered still image of a dead fish lying flat in a human palm with crude yellow text (*"EYES INSIDE ITS HEAD?"*). The actual live 4K footage of the barreleye fish is never shown anywhere in the entire video—even when discussed in detail from 05:08 to 07:25, the video just loops back to the same dead fish still photo.
